lines.cap: She only comes once every seventy six years, and everyone stops to watch.
lines.say: She only comes once every seventy six years, and everyone stops to watch.

lines.cap: Halley's Comet. A dirty snowball, fifteen kilometres long.
lines.say: Halley's Comet. A dirty snowball, fifteen kilometres long.

lines.cap: She loops past the Sun, then disappears far beyond Neptune, for decades.
lines.say: She loops past the Sun, then disappears far beyond Neptune, for decades.

lines.cap: Mark Twain was born the year she came, in 1835. He said, I came in with it, and I'll go out with it.
lines.say: Mark Twain was born the year she came, in 1835. He said, I came in with it, and I'll go out with it.

lines.cap: He died in 1910, one day after she was closest to the Sun.
lines.say: He died in 1910, one day after she was closest to the Sun.

lines.cap: She leaves dust behind. Every May and October, it lights up our sky as shooting stars.
lines.say: She leaves dust behind. Every May and October, it lights up our sky as shooting stars.

lines.cap: So mark the date. She won't wait for you.
lines.say: So mark the date. She won't wait for you.
